notes: Fictional subject: a newly found manuscript of a real poem, the kind of thing that could exist unrecorded (README). Determinate: two compositions through Beowulf (language, Grendel attacks Hrothgar's hall). Indeterminate (background beliefs): the count of manuscripts, stored as a number (w1) or as a list (w2). The uniqueness question ('Is the Nowell Codex the only surviving manuscript?') is determinate 'no' since 2026-10-31: a world that keeps 'the only one' while holding a second, different manuscript is not consistent (formal check, FINDINGS A1). The near query asks the real manuscript (Nowell Codex), a real thing the insert touches; a leak would name the Ostrevane Codex. Relation manuscript_of is real (catalogued in the scratch relations file).
